stem: What is the most likely reason the National Park Service chose the three goals mentioned in paragraph 5 for the project?

options.label: A
options.text: It wanted the work of HARP to create accurate portrayals of history that would last.

options.label: B
options.text: It wanted to provide opportunities for HARP volunteers to learn aircraft maintenance skills.

options.label: C
options.text: It wanted to be sure the planes restored by HARP would not be flown for other purposes.

options.label: D
options.text: It wanted HARP researchers to discover information that could be useful for future aircraft.
